newsitem.title: USA: Pall sees meeting 1997 earnings growth goal.
newsitem.headline: Pall sees meeting 1997 earnings growth goal.

text.p: Pall Corp said on Monday that it expected to meet its goal of hitting at least 15 percent earnings growth in 1997.
It also expected to see 10 percent unit and price growth in sales during fiscal 1997, Pall said.
"We expect to meet both of these objectives," it said.
The company reported first quarter earnings of $0.18 compared with $0.16 in the same period last year.
Pall said it posted only single-digit growth in the first quarter because of the microelectronics environment and a general weakness in Europe.
Current exchange rates were expected to reduce sales by one percent for the year, but the tax rate was not expected to exceed 30 percent this year, the company said.
